jd: QA paraphrase of ICON public vacancy JR121420, retrieved October 28, 2026. Clinical Trial Manager II, Biotech, U.S. remote, with general-medicine therapeutic alignment. Responsibilities include clinical budget oversight, monitoring plans, CRA training and mentoring, study start-up and enrollment timelines, trip-report review, corrective and preventive actions, and sponsor/vendor/cross-functional relationships. The Level 2 profile requires at least two years in a CTM position at a CRO, a relevant bachelor's degree and at least eight years of relevant experience. Two years of monitoring is strongly preferred. Complex or global trial management, start-up through database-lock experience and mentoring other CTMs are preferred. Evaluate mandatory versus preferred criteria separately. Associate CTM duties must not automatically be treated as two years of qualifying CTM ownership. Exact eligibility, vacancy status and title equivalence require employer confirmation.
